name: Nugasete Yakyuuken -Meikko no Rina-chan-
original_name: 脱がせて野球拳 -姪っ子のりなちゃん-
source:
You're Rina's uncle, and the two of you are going to play rock-paper-strippers.
If you win three times, you get a sexy prize!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE302090.html]DLsite English[/url]]
